verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a SaaS remote-access platform that exposes a Web API, so the axis applies. The pack only shows that a Web API and its docs exist. Nothing documents issuing API tokens with restricted scopes or least-privilege permissions for an agent. Community posts about saved client passwords concern a different credential type and do not bear on API token scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
